title: Chuckie Egg 2
build: one-file whole-memory image, $0314-$FFFF, started by an IRQ hook at $033C (chuckie-egg-2.prg, MD5 feba9b149adc49799ba1f58201ef344a); the same kind of file as games/c64/i-ball's, which came from the OneLoad64 games collection; where this one came from is not recorded

exclude: runtime: zero page, the game's variables (named in the listing) and the pointers its routines use
system: the KERNAL's work area and vectors, which the game does not use once it runs
runtime: the screen and the sprite pointers, drawn by room_clear, draw_room and the front end's printing
never read: VICE's power-on fill around the interrupt and tune code (the code itself is counted)
runtime: the shadow copy of the screen that room_finish makes and the take and collect code copy back
runtime: the property map under the screen, built by plot_cell as each room is drawn
never read: VICE's power-on fill after rooms_visited
runtime: Harry's movement and the restart point ($1C00-$1C0F), set by player_init; the rest is power-on fill
runtime: the creature records ($1D00, 26 bytes each) and the list of them ($1E00), built by creatures_setup and creatures_move; the rest is power-on fill
never read: VICE's power-on fill after key_check (redefine_keys writes $888F, the byte before key_table, as a sentinel)
never read: VICE's power-on fill between key_table and the pick-ups' pictures
never read: zeros and VICE's power-on fill after note_table
never read: VICE's power-on fill after the tape saver
runtime: save_buffer, filled by save_table and read by tape_restore
not the game's: VICE's power-on fill and, at $FD30, a copy of the KERNAL's vector table that nothing reads (start_after_load reads the ROM's)

regions: the character set: scenery, the pick-ups' cells and two fonts
128 sprite shapes: Harry, the creatures, the train, the dog, the van, the big creature and the lift
the creature list: room, y, column and type of 256 creatures
the object table and the pick-ups' shapes
a fragment of the BBC BASIC source
the 120 room records and their table
